title: New Jersey Association on Aerial Phenomena letterhead: NJ map with flying saucer (1962)
description: Letter dated September 19, 1962 on New Jersey Association on Aerial Phenomena letterhead featuring a large hatched illustration of the outline of New Jersey with a flying saucer streaking across it. A stamped address reads "state filter center #1, 69 hobart street, Hackensack, N.J." The typed letter, signed by the association's secretary, asks the FBI for information on a recent UFO sighting by two police officers; FBI file number 100-36998-28 and declassification stamps appear at bottom.
